title: End-of-Life Vehicles Regulation (EU) 2026/1738
notes: Recorded with no bindings, deliberately: the act exists and creates a Circularity Vehicle Passport, and we hold no vehicle product group to bind it to. An instrument that reaches nothing we model is still worth holding — it is how the catalog stops the act being rediscovered as new, and it is the shape a horizontal act takes before its groups are known. Full requirements cover passenger cars and light commercial vans, with a reduced end-of-life-treatment set for heavy-duty vehicles, motorcycles and special-purpose vehicles. No passport date is recorded: the application date is 'two years after entry into force' from a secondary source and has not been read out of the OJ text (CELEX 32026R1738). This Regulation also amends Annex I of the Batteries Regulation through its own Annex XII. Note the relationship with ESPR: Art. 1(2)(h) excludes vehicles only in respect of aspects already regulated by sector-specific acts, so the exclusion is partial and aspect-scoped, and this Regulation is the automotive passport route.
